Marketing.title: 7days 7posts
Marketing.content:
Monday – Momentum Monday
Monday feels heavy? Perfect — that's when most people quit before starting.
Today: Pick ONE tiny action from the FirstOneDollarOnline blueprint (post a service offer, share a quick tip, DM someone).
Momentum beats motivation. One micro-step today compounds.
What's your ONE action for Momentum Monday? Drop it below 
#FirstOneDollarOnline  firstonedollaronline.com Tuesday – Test Tuesday
Tuesday = test day. No more overthinking.
Post your first imperfect offer somewhere real (X reply, Reddit thread, Discord, Gumroad $1 product, whatever feels scary but doable).
The goal isn't perfection — it's proof someone will pay $1.
Even a "no" teaches you faster than planning forever.
What are you testing today? Share your post link if brave 
#FirstOneDollarOnline  firstonedollaronline.com Wednesday – Win Wednesday
Halfway through the week — celebrate micro-wins, no matter how small.
Made a post? Replied to someone? Got a view? That's fuel.
The first $1 often hides in consistent small actions, not one big launch.
What's your tiniest "win" so far this week? Reply — let's hype each other up!
#FirstOneDollarOnline  firstonedollaronline.com Thursday – Threshold Thursday
Thursday is when doubt creeps in: "Is this even worth it?"
Reminder: The threshold from $0 to $1 is 99% mental.
Use the kit's psychology nudges — reframe "What if it fails?" to "What if it works for $1?"
Lower the bar, raise the action.
What's the biggest mental block you're pushing through today? Let's troubleshoot in replies.
#FirstOneDollarOnline  firstonedollaronline.com Friday – Feedback Friday
Friday energy: Ask for real input before the weekend.
Share what you've tried this week (offer, post, script) and ask the community: "What would make you pay $1 for this?"
Feedback is free money — it shortens the path dramatically.
Drop your thing below and tag someone for honest thoughts.
Let's make each other better.
#FirstOneDollarOnline  firstonedollaronline.com Saturday – Ship Saturday
Weekend = prime shipping time (no job distractions for most).
Today: Ship something sellable, even if tiny.
A $1 template tweak, a quick service in DMs, a "pay what you want" post.
Remember my rule: One thing per week with real $1 potential. Saturday's your day.
What are you shipping today? Post proof/link — accountability squad assemble! 
#FirstOneDollarOnline  firstonedollaronline.com Sunday – Setup Sunday
Sunday reset: Prep for the week ahead so $0 doesn't become $0 forever.
Review your streak tracker from the kit, tweak your offer based on feedback, line up 3 places to post next week.
Rest, but don't stop — small setup today = easier wins tomorrow.
How's your streak looking? Share your Sunday setup plan below.
Be happy  Let's cross that line together.
#FirstOneDollarOnline  firstonedollaronline.com
